In t02, neither the ordered samples nor frames 84–96 show a visible initiating lift or resulting change."},{"gate":"focal-hierarchy","status":"PASS","evidence":"In both caption modes and both variants, the large layered SOURCE sheet beside Bot is readable at mobile size and commands attention.
